evidence_scope: Current-main source plus portable Linux tests. No owned-Android result is claimed.

model.evidence: The router targets 127.0.0.1:8080, but the managed llama.cpp runtime remains on draft PR #12 and no real offline answer is verified.

memory.evidence: SQLite conversation memory exists on main; bounded RAG, provenance controls, export/edit/delete, and retention remain in WP-04.

voice.evidence: No wake-word, VAD, offline ASR, expressive TTS, or barge-in implementation exists on main.

avatar.evidence: No verified state engine, signed pack reader, renderer, or lip-sync runtime exists on main.

device.evidence: Fail-closed allowlisted device bridge and measured-only CrowRF paths passed 55 portable tests; physical Termux commands are not claimed.

notification.evidence: An allowlisted device.notify tool is registered; owned-device permission and delivery remain unverified.

storage.evidence: SQLite memory and append-only CrowRF measurement storage pass integrity, mutation-blocking, and corruption tests.

process.evidence: Only fixed Termux executable paths run without shell expansion; actual Android command availability is a separate device gate.

network.evidence: Loopback bind, Host, Origin, and DNS-rebinding boundaries pass portable tests; no public bind is enabled by default.

presentation.evidence: The Python runtime serves a loopback mobile web UI; overlay and wallpaper presentation are not implemented on main.
